flight_azimuth.description: Clockwise degrees from CRS north; caller resolves true/grid convergence.

line_spacing.description: Measured flight-line spacing in CRS linear units.

max_abs_correction.description: Application cap in nT; never clips.

protected_bounds.description: Inclusive cell-centre [xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax] boxes in map coordinates; explicit [] permitted.

input.coordinates: Explicit rectangular projected/local affine with known CRS or local frame_id, declared linear crs_units.

model.azimuth: Clockwise from CRS north; along=(sin az,cos az), across=(cos az,-sin az).
model.preparation: Best-fit plane removed using only valid unprotected cells; gaps/protected cells plane-filled internally; symmetric mirror padding at along cutoff capped to each source dimension, rounded to powers of two. Real inverse FFT implies conjugate-bin averaging at oblique Nyquist axes.

assumptions: Residual grid striping only; caller verifies prior line levelling, anomaly/reference context, geometry and sampling. No raw-field, tie, heading/lag or drape correction is inferred.
Along cutoff >=2*across cutoff, across cutoff >=2*line spacing; cell sizes <=line spacing/2. Grid spans at least one along cutoff and four line spacings across.

Protected valid cell centres are excluded from plane/FFT training; correction is zero there and within edge_margin_cells of the rectangular boundary. Each protection box must include a valid input centre. Original missing cells remain missing.

Minimum 64 unprotected samples and caller min_training_fraction (0.25..1) of all cells; at least one eligible interior application cell. Gaps and artificial boundaries can cause artefacts despite these checks.

Directional spectra cannot distinguish geological anomalies from identical line noise. Caller must acknowledge overlap and choose protection, parameters and cap; RMS reduction is not geological validation.
Estimation returns candidate/diagnostics even above cap; application recomputes from original and rejects over-cap candidates atomically, never clips. Applied grid status prevents repetition.
Both workflow operations require named verified input grids, not outputs from prior steps; run transforms separately and verify their actual context/support first.

Original source/history/uncertainty is archived in input_lineage, not propagated to an unsupported error estimate. This original Gaussian grid algorithm is not a vendor/Minty implementation or located-line correction.
